reading_note: The teaching unfolds the threefold descent of divine truth from the Father into reception. The three names — gods, rich-ones, angels — correspond to three discrete degrees by which the one Divine extends itself: the celestial degree of emanations directly summoned by the Father (gods of the house of Greatness/Spirit), the spiritual degree of those summoned in turn by the first emanations (rich-ones, who execute the purpose and contend against evil), and the natural-rational degree of those summoned by the rich-ones (angels, sent in embassy to bring hope to souls). The single arc: how one Divine Love communicates itself outward through successive degrees of calling, until it reaches the human soul as hope and trust.
